Hi Olivia — thanks for the form and the details. Looping in Kimberly from AP and Marissa from vendor ops to help complete the master.

Checklist of what we need to create the vendor record and route POs:
- Legal entity legal name + any DBAs (you included the legal name; confirm if any DBAs)
- Tax doc: PDF W-9 for US entities (EIN letter acceptable if W-9 is not available)
- Remit-to address + preferred remittance method (ACH or check)
- AP contact: name, email, phone for invoice follow-ups
- Authorized signer for contracts (name + title + email)
- Banking details: we collect via DocuSign (secure) if you plan to enable ACH
- Any special PO terms (Net30/Net45/PO required for payment)

We prefer invoices via the vendor portal for tracking; accounts@redwood.ai also works if you attach the PO number. Standard terms are Net30 unless otherwise negotiated.

Next steps:
- Olivia: please send W-9 and remit-to info (or confirm that remit=billing address).
- Kimberly: I’ll ask you to review the onboarding_form and confirm required fields and any missing items.
- Marissa: can you prepare the vendor portal invite once Olivia confirms remit-to?

I’ve provisionally created a vendor placeholder (internal id VW-98731) so AP can reference it during the PO. Once we have the W-9 and remit details we’ll finalize the profile and send a portal invite + DocuSign for bank details.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
